title: What is CloudDash and How Does It Work?
content:
CloudDash is an enterprise-grade cloud monitoring and analytics platform that provides unified visibility across your entire cloud infrastructure. Whether you are running workloads on AWS, Azure, GCP, or a hybrid combination, CloudDash aggregates metrics, logs, and events into a single pane of glass, enabling your team to detect issues, understand trends, and act before problems impact customers.

## How CloudDash Works

CloudDash operates as a SaaS platform that connects to your cloud accounts via read-only API credentials (IAM roles, service principals, or service accounts). Once connected, CloudDash's ingestion pipeline continuously pulls metrics at configurable intervals — as frequently as every 60 seconds on Pro and Enterprise plans.

### Core Components

**Data Sources:** CloudDash supports AWS CloudWatch, Azure Monitor, GCP Cloud Monitoring, and custom metrics via the CloudDash Metrics API. Each connected data source is called an Integration.

**Dashboards:** Drag-and-drop dashboard builder with 30+ widget types including line charts, heatmaps, service maps, and alert status panels. Dashboards are shareable via public links or restricted to workspace members.

**Alerts:** Define threshold-based or anomaly-detection alerts on any metric. Route alerts to Slack, PagerDuty, email, or any webhook endpoint.

**Logs:** Ingest structured or unstructured logs via the CloudDash Log Ingestion API. Logs are searchable and can be correlated with metric spikes on the same timeline.

## Data Security

CloudDash never stores your cloud credentials in plaintext. All credentials are encrypted at rest using AES-256 and in transit using TLS 1.3. CloudDash is SOC 2 Type II compliant and supports SAML SSO for enterprise customers.

## Getting Started

See the Getting Started with CloudDash guide (kb-019) for a step-by-step onboarding walkthrough. You can connect your first cloud account in under 10 minutes.
